description: Docker image for a self-hosted Docling document parsing server. Converts PDF, DOCX, PPTX, HTML, and more to Markdown/JSON. Powered by IBM Docling. Features sync/async conversion, chunking for RAG, NVIDIA GPU (CUDA) acceleration, optional web UI, offline mode, and persistent model cache. Multi-arch: amd64, arm64.
